d: Short jet black hair with straight bangs and a sleek texture is partially hidden by a hood. Narrow, sharp-looking deep crimson eyes peek from a youthful, mature face partially obscured by a high orange and white fabric neck gaiter. The build is slender, dressed in a short-sleeved orange hooded jumpsuit with matching shorts, paired with knee-high black boots. A black rectangular placard with white inscriptions is held in front, and a heavy dark metal chain is draped across the waist and legs.
